suites.failingCase: normalizes tenant industry codes before canonical lookup
suites.rationale: Red 1 of 5. The case expects normalizeCanonicalIndustry('healthcare_idn') to be 'healthcare' and 'banking' to be 'financial_services'; the code returns 'healthcare_provider' and 'financial_services_banking'. All four values are members of CANONICAL_INDUSTRIES, and test and code arrive in the same squash commit, so which family a tenant industry code belongs to is a taxonomy call, not a fixture fix. Not edited here; T-783 carries the decision.
